### 5‑Day Instagram Content Plan for Faded Archive Tee Launch

| Day | Post Type | Caption (≈30 words) | Visual Idea | CTA |
|-----|-----------|---------------------|-------------|-----|
| **1** | Teaser | “Something fresh is coming to your wardrobe—stay tuned. #FadedArchive” | Close‑up of the new logo on a dark background, subtle glow. | “Tag a friend who loves unique tees.” |
| **2** | Behind‑the‑scenes | “From sketch to shirt—see our creative process in action.” | Time‑lapse of a tee being printed / hand‑shaped. | “Like if you love handmade design.” |
| **3** | Product spotlight | “Limited‑run ‘Midnight Meadow’ tee—soft cotton, bold print. Get yours before it disappears.” | High‑quality image of the tee on a model, natural lighting. | “Swipe up to shop now.” |
| **4** | Customer‑generated content | “Thanks to @user for rocking our tee! Share yours with #FadedFresh for a chance to be featured.” | Collage of user photos. | “Submit your photo in the Stories.” |
| **5** | Launch reminder | “Tomorrow we go live! 24h countdown. Set a reminder 🌙 #LaunchAlert” | Countdown graphic, animated LED timer. | “Follow us for the launch.” |

---

### eBay UK Fees for Clothing (General Estimate)

| Type | Base Flat‑Rate | Percent of Sale |
|------|----------------|-----------------|
| Standard listings | **£3.00** | **6 %** of final sale price |
| “Sold Items” below £50 | **£2.56** | **6 %** |

So for a typical tee sold at £30, you’d pay £3.00 + (£30 × 0.06) = **£4.80** in total fees.  

*(Check the current seller‑center fee schedule for any changes.)*
